description: SSH client config audit — Offline audit of an OpenSSH CLIENT config (~/.ssh/config or /etc/ssh/ssh_config; text or url, GitHub blob links work, one-line input is split on keywords). Flags StrictHostKeyChecking no, UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null, ForwardAgent and trusted X11 on wildcard hosts, weak ciphers/MACs/KEX, ssh-dss and ssh-rsa (SHA-1), DSA keys, keys or ControlPath sockets in /tmp, long ControlPersist, GSSAPI delegation, GatewayPorts, risky ProxyCommand, cleartext known_hosts, Host * placed before specific hosts (first value wins), Include files and unknown keywords. Returns verdict PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, score, grade, findings with line and host block, and a host list. For the server side use /v1/security/sshd-check. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Host * StrictHostKeyChecking no UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null ForwardAgent yes

name: security_ssh_config_check
